identitySignals: Agenda name 'LPS Oakland R&D' matches the Oakland R&D campus of Leadership Public Schools, listed on leadps.org as 'LPS Oakland R&D'

California Department of Education directory lists 'LPS Oakland R & D Campus', a public charter high school in Oakland, CA at 8601 MacArthur Blvd. with website www.leadps.org, matching OUSD's Proposition 39 facilities use agreement via the Office of Charter Schools
Leadership Public Schools Inc is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit in Oakland, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), which operates the charter schools
research.notes: The agenda vendor 'LPS Oakland R&D' is a campus (charter school) of Leadership Public Schools; the profile describes the operating nonprofit, Leadership Public Schools Inc. The campus is authorized by the Alameda County Office of Education per the CDE directory (https://sd.cde.ca.gov/schooldirectory/details?cdscode=01100170126748). The campus phone is (510) 633-0750; the network main line is used here. Reviewer may want to confirm the contracting legal entity is Leadership Public Schools Inc. Entity number and UEI not looked up.

profile.summary: Leadership Public Schools is a nonprofit that operates a network of three charter high schools in the Bay Area, in Hayward, Oakland and Richmond. Its schools focus on preparing students for college, career and life. LPS Oakland R&D is its Oakland campus.

sources.title: Leadership Public Schools Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: leadps.org lists LPS Oakland R&D as one of its three campuses and shows the stated HQ address, phone and email; ProPublica confirms Leadership Public Schools Inc, EIN 73-1643646, a 501(c)(3) in Oakland. The CDE directory confirms the Oakland charter campus. The summary is neutral and supported, and the contact details are the network's business details, not the campus's.
